evidence.detail: Four ads for the same unit from 2015-03 to 2026-01 code 1 full and 0 half baths with 689 sq ft. Ad 4955756's text says "Residence 16J at 2 Northside Piers is a spacious 689-square-foot studio, one-bath with an oversized home office".

Ad text: "Amazing convertible 1 bed with a separate home office", the same copy as three of the unit's other ads. The row codes a studio with 4 full baths. The set leaves the bedroom count alone, since the unit's ads split between 1 bedroom and a studio.

22 ads for the building's front units on floors 2 to 5 (2FE, 2FW, 3FE, 4FE, 4FW, 5F, 5FW) code 1 full and 0 half baths, and so do all 45 other ads in the building. The first 12 front-unit ads are listed.
Ad text: "Gorgeous and super spacious studio apartment in the heart of Hell’s Kitchen!! Second floor". The row codes a studio with 4 full baths, and the unit has no other ads.
Three ads for the same unit from 2018-06 to 2024-02 code 3 bedrooms, 2 full and 0 half baths; ad 4353311's text says "Two full updated baths".
The row codes a studio with 4 full baths, its ad offers a 1-bedroom, and the unit's other ads describe a 3-bedroom with 2 baths. No count fits all of them.
